runningGags.premise: Bengaluru is periodically hit by 'epidemics of laughter' traced back to Cubbon Park jams; authorities remain baffled and enjoy it
The Great Hoop Shortage — hoops keep 'mysteriously vanishing' whenever @hoopwithsupriya posts or gains followers
The Laughter Index, reported daily in the weather box like the air quality index, is never below 'chance of giggles'
Captain Technofire denies setting the sky on fire; eyewitnesses disagree
The ₹100 Sunday staff jam 'includes the staff', a value proposition that breaks economists

canonEvents.summary: Vol I, No. 1 goes to print. Lead: Cubbon Park's ₹100 Sunday staff jam secedes from seriousness. Google India breached; Supriya's hoop empire hits 8,885; Mufasa resigns from smallness; Dapostar Level 2 opens. The Badger declines to comment.

styleNotes: headlines are always slightly too dramatic for the event being described
affectionate, never mean — real people from captions become recurring heroes
Bengaluru specifics encouraged: Cubbon Park, HSR, Indiranagar, Church Street, auto rides, Silk Board traffic, sudden rain, filter coffee
the weather box reports the Laughter Index instead of the weather
